Learned counsel for the GNCTD has handed over a judgment passed by the Supreme Court in Government of NCT of Delhi and Another v. BSK Realtors LLP and Another, 2024 SCC OnLine SC 1092 where case of the Petitioners was also part of the batch petitions being considered by the Court and submits that the Supreme Court has extended the time limit for initiation of fresh acquisition proceedings in terms of provisions contained in Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by one year, This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 12/12/2024 at 22:06:11 starting from 01.08.2024, whereupon compensation to the effected land owners may be paid in accordance with law, failing which consequence also as per law shall follow.

It is also pointed out that the Supreme Court has further directed that the parties shall maintain status quo regarding possession, change of land dues, creation of third-party rights till fresh acquisition proceedings as directed by the Supreme Court.
